newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Time says mulls unit listing delay.
newsitem.headline: Time says mulls unit listing delay.

text.p: Malaysian telecommunications and construction group Time Engineering Bhd said on Tuesday it may consider delaying the stock listing of its unit Time Telecommunications Holdings Bhd.
"We are considering the situation. We are looking at the entire deal in terms of its structure, price and timing," said Kamarudin Abu Bakar, group managing director of Time Engineering.
Kamarudin was speaking to reporters after the company's annual general meeting.
A company official later told Reuters the listing of Time Telekom is currently scheduled for "the third or fourth quarter" of 1997.
But "because of the market, we are deliberating on the issue especially on the timing," said the official.
Several new issues have been either delayed or have debuted below market expectations in recent months after the local bourse's lacklustre performance.
The benchmark Composite Index has slumped around 12 percent since the end of February.
Time Engineering said in February its proposed initial public offering would consist of 470 million new shares at 1.25 ringgit each.
Time Telecommunications operates a digital cellular telephone network and has built a 900 kilometre fibre-optic cable link stretching the length of the country's North-South Expressway.
Time Engineering is a part of the Renong Bhd group of companies, which is one of the country's largest infrastructure developers.
